d: Bihar ke bhojpur jile men vishesh shakha men tainat havaldar harendr sinh ke putr ritik sinh ki goli markar hatya kie jane ke bad guruvar der sham logon ka gussa sarkon par phut para. aakroshit parijnon aur sthaniy logon ne shav ke sath navada thana kshetr ke chandva mor ke samip aara-baksar haeeve ko puri tarah jam kar diya. pradarshankariyon ne bich sarak par tayar jalakar aagajni ki aur pulis prashasan ke khilaph jamkar narebaji ki.
